narrative.overview: 4LIFE Admin is a high-clarity operational cockpit designed for back-office administrators and moderators overseeing an accommodation and homestay marketplace. It unites rigorous moderation workflows with an inviting, modern aesthetic. The visual atmosphere is clean, tactile, and confident, leveraging soft ambient shadows, frosted glass navigation planes, and vibrant Living Coral accents that signal hospitality and brand energy while rejecting spreadsheet clutter and neon noise.
keyCharacteristics: Elevated Canvas Planes: Crisp white cards resting over a soft cloud background (#f0f2f5) create layered spatial depth.
Decisive Accent Hierarchy: Living Coral (#ff385c) is reserved strictly for core commits, active navigation cues, and priority calls to action.
Unobstructed Evidence Display: Document verification panels present identity artifacts at native proportions without obscuring watermarks or crops.
Tactile Micro-Feedback: Buttons and drawer tabs feature smooth cubic-bezier transitions, elevated hover responses, and clear active states.

rules.name: The Accent Rarity Rule
rules.body: Living Coral is used strictly on actionable decisions, active navigation pills, and critical status markers. It must never cover large container backgrounds or decorative wallpaper.

rules.name: The Status Exclusivity Rule
rules.body: Semantic colors (Emerald, Amber, Crimson) communicate system truth exclusively; they are never commandeered for ornamental illustration.

rules.name: The Structural Contrast Rule
rules.body: Pair bold headers (fontWeight: 700, Slate Navy #344767) directly with lighter, secondary labels (fontWeight: 400, Muted Slate #7b809a) to establish instant scanning hierarchies in high-density views.

rules.name: The Single-Plane Elevation Rule
rules.body: Cards provide the single elevated plane above the canvas background. Elements nested inside a card remain flat or use soft background tints rather than introducing secondary drop shadows.

dos: Do preserve the natural aspect ratio of applicant ID documents (front and back) to guarantee verification accuracy.
Do use rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6) with backdrop-filter: blur(30px) on sticky headers to keep underlying content subtly visible without harming text contrast.
Do reinforce moderation decisions with clear colored icons and text (e.g. Check for Accept, Close for Reject).
Do pair data table loading cycles with smooth linear indicators rather than blocking entire screens.
donts: Don't crop, tilt, or distort national identity card document uploads in moderation workflows.
Don't use solid black borders or harsh gridlines across data tables; rely on subtle dividers (#dee2e6) and white row cards.
Don't use Living Coral for destructive actions; rejections and deletions must remain Signal Crimson (#F44335).
Don't stack multiple drop shadows inside a single card container.
